title: Riemannian Difference-of-Convex Optimization for K-Means Clustering
summary: K-means is a widely adopted clustering approach in signal processing and machine learning. In this paper, we study K-means clustering through a cardinality-constrained formulation on a compact embedded submanifold. We replace the cardinality constraint with a difference-of-convex (DC) penalty and establish a global error bound to prove that the penalized and constrained formulations share the same global minimizers whenever the penalty parameter exceeds a finite threshold.
